included: visible opening greetings and scene narration
excluded: Cupid fixed story dialogue and choices
loading indicators and administrative UI notices
hidden prompts and internal AI instructions

productionEvidence.source: chat_render_acks LEFT JOIN chat_logs by app/user/client message ID
productionEvidence.note: Receipts prove these missing rows; absence of a receipt cannot prove a message was never displayed.

findings.trigger: A user sees their input but generation fails, hangs or becomes stale
findings.fix: Queue user message before rendering/AI awaits; correlate later writes with the same message ID

findings.trigger: Leave or renderer throws between pair speakers or during an automatic greeting/opening narration
findings.fix: Archive prepared parts before renderer callbacks; keep gameplay rollback separate from immutable display audit

findings.trigger: A fixed opening greeting or FreeTalk opening is shown without an AI request
findings.fix: Queue newly displayed opening messages; do not log hidden prompts or fixed Cupid story scenes

findings.trigger: A visible stream is interrupted before final response processing
findings.fix: Journal stream previews and promote correlated final rows; late previews cannot replace finalized text

findings.trigger: A message or display receipt exceeds 8000 characters
findings.fix: Remove lossy truncation; keep complete text and archive inline image bytes in R2 before D1 acknowledgement

findings.trigger: Two tabs enqueue from the same snapshot or an old in-flight write completes after a final revision
findings.fix: Per-message storage journals, acknowledgement markers and revision-aware removal; retain memory fallback during storage failure

findings.trigger: A render receipt reaches D1 but its chat row does not
findings.fix: Idempotently recover the missing assistant row from actual rendered text; later canonical logs preserve correlation

findings.trigger: AI draft broadcast is displayed, then retracted or interrupted
findings.fix: Persist drafts before broadcast; preserve normal public delivery sequences and retain interrupted drafts as filtered audit rows. Remove an unflushed draft only when its final archived segment contains the complete draft.

findings.trigger: Final D1 flush fails twice after a room closes, or backlog exceeds the final batch
findings.fix: Keep durable alarm retries and drain remaining batches for closed rooms

findings.trigger: HTTP 200 is returned without an explicit D1 persistence acknowledgement
findings.fix: Require ok:true before removing a queued record; retain invalid responses for retry

verification.chatbotAndHaremRealBrowserChat: Passed mocked provider and D1 transport using actual application UI
verification.notes: Production and local verification use synthetic audit messages. Existing narration, prompts, scores, route logic, UI and backend version constants are unchanged.

limits: An offline browser that permanently loses all local storage before any server receipt cannot provide recoverable data. Memory fallback keeps pending messages while the page remains open.
Historical missing messages without either a receipt or surviving browser/server source cannot be reconstructed from absent data.
